CustomField.description: How a text field displays on the form. Standard is the single-line input. Text Area shows a multi-line box sized by the Text Area minimum and maximum heights. Selector options (icon, form component, email template, image asset, style sheet) are offered in Form Builder only for fields whose API name suggests that purpose, and each still saves a plain text value with the rest of the form. Part of Form Builder's per-type display settings, alongside the number, picklist and lookup display types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overrides how a text field displays on the form. Text Area renders a multi-line input with configurable minimum and maximum height. Selector options appear only for fields whose API name matches the selector's purpose.
CustomField.label: stringType
